function.name: file_edit
function.description: Edit files inside the current workspace by applying a small patch. Use this for creating, updating, deleting, or moving files. The patch string must start with '*** Begin Patch' and its last non-empty line must be exactly '*** End Patch'.

patch.description: Raw patch text only. Before calling, verify the first line is exactly '*** Begin Patch' and the last non-empty line is exactly '*** End Patch'. Do not omit the closing line.
